observations: Photo 0: a compact portable domestic sewing machine, pink/white, brand plate reads 'RICCAR' (or similar), dial markings, watermark 'MARTEX GLOBAL' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'
Photo 1: a different white domestic sewing machine, brand plate reads 'Semco Indigo 6', with a 'SINGER' sticker visible in background, same watermark
Photo 2: a third, different machine, brand plate reads 'NOVAMATIC NM868A', same watermark

All three photos show small/medium domestic or semi-domestic portable machines with plastic dial selectors, not the heavy metal flatbed/cylinder-arm construction typical of an industrial sewing machine
No single consistent machine appears across the three photos; three distinct brands/models are shown
Watermarks indicate these are stock/dealer images reposted from a listing site, not necessarily original photos of the item being sold

claims.evidence: All three photos show compact domestic/portable-style machines, not industrial flatbed machines
No origin marking legible in any photo; brand names shown (Riccar-like, Semco, Novamatic) are not clearly Japanese industrial brands
No video or running demonstration provided

claims.claim: All accessories and original manual included
claims.evidence: No photo of accessories or manual shown

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service history or receipts shown; unprovable remotely

risks.risk: Photos show three different machines, so it's unclear which (if any) is the actual item for sale
risks.proof: A single clear photo of the actual machine being sold, with nameplate and surroundings matching across multiple angles
risks.if_unproven: treated as unidentified/unreliable listing, priced at lowest comparable tier

risks.risk: Claimed 'industrial' machine may actually be a domestic/semi-industrial unit worth far less
risks.proof: A full-body photo showing the machine's base/stand (industrial machines have a table-mounted clutch motor and flatbed, not a portable case)
A video clip of the machine running and stitching
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / worst case

risks.risk: Reused stock/dealer photos suggest possible misrepresentation or scam
risks.proof: Live photo with today's date/newspaper or seller holding the item
risks.if_unproven: treated as high fraud risk, listing credibility low

proof_requests: A clear photo of the actual machine being sold, including its stand/motor/base, matching the seller's description
A video of the machine running and sewing a sample seam
A photo of the nameplate/model number on the actual unit, legible
Photos of the included accessories and manual
A live photo with a handwritten note/date to confirm current possession
response.reason: The three photos show three distinct, different domestic-style sewing machines (none clearly industrial) carrying dealer watermarks, which contradicts the 'industrial Japanese machine' claim and suggests reused stock images rather than photos of one real item for sale.
